description: Register a DocuSignResource (JWT Grant OAuth2 eSignature REST API client) for use by other components

outputs.description: DocuSign eSignature REST API resource (JWT Grant OAuth2).

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

integration_key.label: Integration Key
integration_key.description: DocuSign Integration Key (client ID) with an RSA keypair registered for JWT grant.

user_id.label: User ID
user_id.description: GUID of the DocuSign user being impersonated (must have granted one-time JWT consent).

private_key.label: Private Key
private_key.description: RSA private key (PEM format) matching the public key registered on the Integration Key.

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: Specific DocuSign account ID. If unset, the default account from the JWT userinfo response is used.

use_demo_env.label: Use Demo Env
use_demo_env.description: Use DocuSign's demo/sandbox environment (account-d.docusign.com) instead of production.

name: DocuSign Resource
